title: An autonomous platform speeds research on polymer mixtures
summary: The platform tests up to 700 mixtures a day (96 at a time), guided by a genetic algorithm: hundreds of mixtures outperformed the individual components, and the best retained 73% enzyme activity, 18% more than the best component. Application is limited to enzyme thermal stability, replenishment is still manual; published in Matter.

evidence.tested: An autonomous platform tested up to 700 polymer mixtures a day, and the best mixtures retained 73% enzyme activity, 18% more than the best component, in a retrospective analysis of the results.
evidence.unknown: The source states application is limited to enzyme thermal stability and replenishment is still manual.
evidence.ai_role: A genetic algorithm guided the choice of polymer mixtures tested by the robotic platform.
